get.description: Liveness: the process is up and serving. Deliberately touches no database.
The fixed permission catalogue roles are built from.

post.description: Provision a user (active, no roles yet). 409 if the email is taken.

patch.description: Rename and/or (de)activate. There is no deletion: deactivate instead.

post.description:
Assign a role within a scope; a null project or language means any. Idempotent: 201
when assigned, 200 when the user already held the role in that scope. 404 if the role,
project or language does not exist.
422 ``unknown_permission`` for a code outside the catalogue (see ``GET /permissions``).

delete.description: 409 while any user holds the role.

get.description: Every registered language, ordered by code.

post.description: Register a language. 409 if the code already exists; 422 if the code or name is invalid.

patch.description: Rename a language. The code is immutable.

get.description: The projects the caller can see: those any of their role assignments covers.

post.description:
Create a project. 422 if the base language does not exist; it cannot change afterwards.
The base language is the project's first language.

patch.description: Edit the name and/or description. The base language is immutable.

delete.description: 409 while the project still has protocols.

get.description: The only languages the project's content may use: its base language first.

put.description:
Add a catalogue language to the project: 201 when added, 200 when it already had it.
404 ``language_not_found`` for a language outside the catalogue. Returns its languages.

delete.description:
422 ``base_language_not_removable`` for the base language; 409
``language_in_use_in_project`` while the project's content uses it; 404
``project_language_not_found`` if the project does not have it.

post.description: Create a protocol under a project. 404 if the project does not exist.

delete.description: 409 while the protocol still has themes.

post.description: Create a theme under a protocol. 404 if the protocol does not exist.

Start a concept with its base-language QA set (its answer). 404 if the theme is unknown;
422 ``unknown_language``, ``language_not_in_project``, or ``base_language_required`` for a
language other than the project's base one (other languages come by translation); 409
``answer_already_exists`` (with its ``concept_id``) if the theme already has the answer.

get.description:
The theme's concepts, each with its QA sets summarised (language, answer, variant
count).

post.description:
Author question-answer pairs in the project's base language. Pairs sharing an answer
(trimmed) form one concept (its base-language QA set), and an answer the theme already has
gains the new questions; repeated questions are skipped. At most ``MAX_QA_PAIRS`` (500)
pairs per request. 422 ``invalid_qa_pairs`` with the offending row indices if a question or
answer is empty (nothing is written).

get.description:
The concept with every QA set (answer, variants, audios, validation state), its intents
and categories.

delete.description: Deletes the concept with all its QA sets.

post.description:
Give the concept a QA set in one of its project's languages by writing its answer. 409
``language_already_present``; 422 ``language_not_in_project``.

Translate the concept's base-language QA set (answer and every variant) into one of the
project's languages: 201 when that language's QA set is created, 200 when the existing one
is updated (answer replaced, missing variants added). 422 ``language_not_in_project``; 502
if the engine fails (nothing saved).

Tag the concept (every language) with a catalogue intent. Idempotent: 201 when attached,
200 when it already was.

delete.description: 404 ``intent_not_attached`` if the concept does not carry the intent.

post.description:
Attach a catalogue category to the concept (every language). Idempotent: 201 when
attached, 200 when it already was.

delete.description: 404 ``category_not_attached`` if the concept does not carry the category.

Remove one language of the concept. 422 ``base_qaset_not_removable`` for the
base-language QA set: delete the concept instead.

patch.description: Edit the QA set's answer; it returns its validation to pending.

post.description:
Translate the variant into another language of its concept, adding it to that
language's QA set: 201 when added, 200 when that QA set already had the translation. 409
``language_presence_required`` if the concept has no QA set in that language yet.

Get-or-create by normalized text (case and whitespace insensitive): 201 when created,
200 with the existing intent otherwise.

get.description: The catalogue ordered by normalized text; ``q`` keeps intents whose text starts with it.

delete.description: 409 while any question variant has the intent attached.

post.description:
Get-or-create by normalized name (case and whitespace insensitive): 201 when created,
200 with the existing category otherwise.

get.description: The catalogue ordered by normalized name; ``q`` keeps names starting with it.

delete.description: 409 while any QA set has the category attached.

post.description:
A term with its optional first forms (one per language; a repeated language keeps its
last form). 404 ``language_not_found``; 422 ``invalid_glossary_field`` naming the field.

get.description:
Terms ordered by label (case-insensitive) with their forms, and the count of every match.
``q`` matches inside the label or any preferred form, synonym or form to avoid, ignoring case
and accents.

patch.description: Change the label and/or the note (``note: null`` clears it).

post.description: Hide the term from the default (active) listing. Idempotent.
Idempotent.

put.description:
Set the term's form in the language: 201 when it had none, 200 when it replaced it (the
form keeps its id). Synonyms and forms to avoid are trimmed, blanks and repeats dropped.
Returns the term.

delete.description: 404 ``glossary_form_not_found`` if the term has no form in the language.

post.description: 422 ``invalid_name`` for a blank name.

patch.description: Change the name and/or the note (``note: null`` clears it).

delete.description: 409 ``voice_in_use`` while any audio is recorded in the voice.

post.description:
Upload (multipart ``file`` and ``voice_id``) the QA set answer's recording in that voice:
201 when set, 200 when it replaced the answer's recording in that voice (other voices are
untouched). 404 ``voice_not_found``; the type is detected from the bytes, 422 if unsupported
or too large.

get.description: The answer's recordings, one per voice, ordered by voice name.

delete.description: Remove the answer's recording in that voice; 404 ``audio_not_found`` if it has none.

post.description:
Upload (multipart ``file`` and ``voice_id``) the variant's recording in that voice: 201
when set, 200 when it replaced the variant's recording in that voice.

get.description: The variant's recordings, one per voice, ordered by voice name.

delete.description: Remove the variant's recording in that voice; 404 ``audio_not_found`` if it has none.

get.description: A short-lived signed URL to play the recording; mint a new one when it expires.

post.description:
Record a clinical decision on the concept's base-language QA set (201 the first time,
200 after). 422 ``not_base_language`` for any other QA set.

Record a decision on the QA set as a translation (its answer and variants together).
422 ``not_a_translation`` for the base-language QA set.

get.description: The active template of every use, shared by everyone.

put.description:
Replace the template for everyone. ``content`` must use exactly the key's
``required_placeholders`` as ``{name}``; write ``{{`` and ``}}`` for literal braces.

post.description:
Propose question variants for the QA set, in its language. Nothing is saved: keep the
chosen ones through ``POST /qasets/{id}/variants``.
Attach a document (multipart ``file``): PDF, Word, plain text, video or image.

get.description: A short-lived signed URL to download the document; mint a new one when it expires.

post.description:
Which notions of the theme's documentation no answer covers, in the project's base
language. Read-only. 409 if the theme has no documentation with readable text.

Export the project's concepts whose base-language QA set is clinically validated, with
every language's QA set, as one Parquet file: ``qa_rows`` (one row per question variant of
each QA set). Read-only. 409 if no concept is clinically validated.

get.description: QA sets with a base-language answer, with that answer and its question variants.
Translated answers and question variants, with the base-language text they translate.
Recordings, with the answer or question variant they voice.

AnswerInLanguageRequest.title: AnswerInLanguageRequest
AnswerInLanguageRequest.description:
Start a concept (in the project's base language), or add a QA set to one, with the
answer in that language.

AssignRoleRequest.title: AssignRoleRequest
AssignRoleRequest.description: A null (or absent) project or language means any.

AssignmentResponse.title: AssignmentResponse
AssignmentResponse.description: A role held within a scope; a null project or language means any.

AudioSummaryResponse.title: AudioSummaryResponse
AudioSummaryResponse.description:
One of an item's recordings (one per voice) as listed in a QA set; play it via its
playback-url.

AudiosResponse.title: AudiosResponse
AudiosResponse.description: An item's recordings, one per voice, ordered by voice name.

CompletenessResponse.title: CompletenessResponse
CompletenessResponse.description: Notions of the theme's documentation that no answer covers yet, in the base language.

ConceptResponse.title: ConceptResponse
ConceptResponse.description:
A concept: its QA sets (one per language, in creation order), and the intents and
categories that apply to it in every language.

ExportResponse.title: ExportResponse
ExportResponse.description: A short-lived signed URL to the Parquet file, and what it contains.

GenerateVariantsRequest.title: GenerateVariantsRequest
GenerateVariantsRequest.description: Free-text guidance for the model (audience, situation...); may be empty.

GrantResponse.title: GrantResponse
GrantResponse.description:
An effective permission within its scope (null means any), normalized to the
permission's scope class: global permissions carry no scope, project ones no language.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description:
The current user, their scoped assignments and effective grants, and every permission
they hold in some scope, for the front to gate its UI.

ProjectLanguagesResponse.title: ProjectLanguagesResponse
ProjectLanguagesResponse.description: A project's languages: its base language first, then the others by code.

PromptTemplateResponse.title: PromptTemplateResponse
PromptTemplateResponse.description: ``updated_by`` is the editor's email; null for the seeded default.

QAPairRequest.title: QAPairRequest
QAPairRequest.description: No language: pairs are always authored in the project's base language.

QASetResponse.title: QASetResponse
QASetResponse.description:
One language of a concept: its answer and question variants. The base-language QA set
carries ``clinical_validation``, every other one ``translation_validation``.

TranslationQueueItemResponse.title: TranslationQueueItemResponse
TranslationQueueItemResponse.description:
A QA set to review as a translation, with its concept's base-language answer and
variants to compare with (None and empty without a base-language QA set).

UpdateGlossaryTermRequest.title: UpdateGlossaryTermRequest
UpdateGlossaryTermRequest.description: PATCH: an absent field is unchanged; ``note: null`` clears the note.

UpdateLanguageRequest.title: UpdateLanguageRequest
UpdateLanguageRequest.description: Only the name is editable; a ``code`` in the body is rejected (it is immutable).

UpdateNamedRequest.title: UpdateNamedRequest
UpdateNamedRequest.description: PATCH: an absent field is unchanged; ``description: null`` clears the description.

UpdateRoleRequest.title: UpdateRoleRequest
UpdateRoleRequest.description: An absent field is unchanged; ``permissions`` replaces the whole set.

UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest
UpdateUserRequest.description: An absent field is unchanged; ``is_active: false`` deactivates the user.

UpdateVoiceRequest.title: UpdateVoiceRequest
UpdateVoiceRequest.description: PATCH: an absent field is unchanged; ``note: null`` clears the note.

ValidationResponse.title: ValidationResponse
ValidationResponse.description: The current state (``pending`` until the first decision) and the full history.

ValidationStateResponse.title: ValidationStateResponse
ValidationStateResponse.description: A current validation state, as shown inside a QA set (``null`` when pending).
